_comment: Units whose tests need assets, tools or sibling checkouts that the publish workflow does not provision. publish.yml refuses such a unit unless the request names it in allow_missing_assets; a named unit runs with RIGHTKIT_REQUIRE_ASSETS=0 and its SKIP markers and skipped tests are recorded in the receipts, never hidden. An unlisted unit runs strict (RIGHTKIT_REQUIRE_ASSETS=1) and fails on a missing asset. scripts/ci/publish.test.mjs fails when a crate or package reads RIGHTKIT_REQUIRE_ASSETS without an entry here.

crates.rightkit-asr: Whisper library (RIGHTKIT_WHISPER_LIB), ASR models and audio fixtures
crates.rightkit-automation: desktop session for the end-to-end tests (e2e_mac, e2e_win)
crates.rightkit-browser: Chrome for Testing for the end-to-end tests
crates.rightkit-motion: ffmpeg binary and encoders for the #[ignore]d tests/encode_e2e.rs (a missing ffmpeg prints SKIP; RIGHTKIT_REQUIRE_ASSETS=1 makes it fail)
crates.rightkit-ocr: OCR models and the OS recognizer
crates.rightkit-playback: FFmpeg binary for the remux end-to-end test (tests/remux_e2e.rs)
crates.rightkit-qa: FFmpeg binary for the media cross-check (tests/media_ffmpeg.rs); its skip-handling tests also print SKIP markers by design
crates.rightkit-vad: ONNX Runtime and the Silero model

npm.@rightkit/release: sibling product checkouts (coderight, heardright, scraperight, ...) beside rightkit
